description: This file defines a logger utility class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log class, and manages a chain of LogNode objects for custom log processing.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class for managing logging operations with different log levels, chaining LogNode objects, and providing static logging methods.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Forwards a log entry to the current LogNode for processing.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
